title: Mahooɓe Towers
intro: E yontaaji ɓennuɗi, siwil doole ummii, ceertuɗo e golle mum maantiniiɗe e mahngo e doole mum kulɓiniiɗe. Ndee fedde renndinde rokkaama jawdi keewndi e doole ɓalli, tee ɓe cuɓii ko laawol luulndingol nulal Alla neldaa ngam ardude e maɓɓe. Daartol maɓɓe ina waɗi jannde luggiɗnde e nder daartol, seedantaagal batte jaɓde goonga.
clues: En ndokkaama semmbe ɓalli e darnde mawnde, nde nanndaani e yimɓe jamaanu men hannde oo.
En nganndiranoo ko mahde cuuɗi mawɗi e cuuɗi toowɗi e kala nokku toowɗo, cikkuɗen en nguurdat haa abada.
Nelaaɗo e nder men nelaama ngam jeertinde en, noddi en yoo en ndew Alla tan, ngoppen sanamuuji men.
En naamndiima nulaaɗo men e mawnikinaare, en naamndii so tawii ɓe ngarii e men tan ko ngam waɗde en rewde Alla e woppude ko taaniraaɓe men ndewatnoo.
Leydi men ina barkini e gese, e ɓulli, e gese ɓutte, kono en ndokkii ɓamtaare men e doole men, wonaa e Tagɗo men.
Ngam majjere men e jaleeɗe men tiiɗɗe, en mbayliima haa laaɓi cer, henndu kulɓiniindu, tikkere, ɓuuɓndu balɗe e jammaaji keewɗi.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Caɗeele ngam yaltinde suuraaji sappo hono Quraan
Jeertineede e annabi ko fayti e ilam garoowo
Jaɓde annabi jeertinoowo mahngo ɓurtungo e rewde sanamuuji
trial.answer: Jaɓde annabi jeertinoowo mahngo ɓurtungo e rewde sanamuuji

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
